product.title: RYSE Loaded Pre MAX
product.body_html:
RYSE Loaded Pre MAX Pre-Workout

A clinically-dosed performance pre-workout built for serious lifters, athletes, and experienced trainers who want a fully transparent, no-proprietary-blend formula with research-backed dosing on every active ingredient. Particularly suited to those who've outgrown entry-level pre-workouts, anyone running heavy training programmes who needs sustained energy and pump support across long sessions, and lifters who want elite-tier ingredient dosing rather than under-dosed marketing claims.

What separates Loaded Pre MAX from the typical pre-workout on the market comes down to dosing philosophy and ingredient transparency. The formula is built around clinical-dose pump and performance ingredients including a substantial dose of L-Citrulline (the gold-standard pump ingredient, dosed at the level shown effective in published research, not the typical token amount), Beta-Alanine for muscular endurance and the lactic-acid buffering effect that delays fatigue during high-rep work, Betaine Anhydrous for power output and cellular hydration, and a focus stack featuring L-Tyrosine for cognitive sharpness alongside a measured caffeine dose for sustained energy. The formula also features the patented elevATP® ingredient for natural ATP production and Nitrosigine® for enhanced nitric oxide and blood flow — premium trademarked ingredients backed by published research. Every active is fully disclosed on the label with exact dosing — no proprietary blends.

RYSE manufactures Loaded Pre MAX in the United States in facilities certified to GMP standards, with rigorous quality control across the range. Note: this specific pre-workout is not Informed-Sport certified — competing tested-pool athletes should always check the most current ingredient panel against their governing body's banned-substance list before use; for everyone else, RYSE's manufacturing pedigree, premium trademarked ingredients, and full label transparency make it one of the more credible options at the high-stim, high-pump end of the pre workout Sri Lanka category. Important caveat: high-stimulant formula — start with a half-scoop to assess tolerance, not for beginners or caffeine-sensitive users.

  • Clinical-dose L-Citrulline for nitric oxide and pump support — at the research-backed level, not a token amount
  • Beta-Alanine and Betaine Anhydrous for muscular endurance, power output, and cellular hydration
  • Nitrosigine® and elevATP® — premium trademarked ingredients for blood flow and natural ATP production
  • Focus stack with L-Tyrosine and a measured caffeine dose for sharp cognitive output and sustained energy without the post-peak crash
  • Fully transparent label, no proprietary blends — strong value at the high-stim end of the pre workout price in Sri Lanka category, useful answer to the perennial pre workout or creatine which is better question (they serve different purposes — most serious lifters use both)

Pair it with a quality whey protein from our protein and recovery range to round out a complete training stack — a pre-workout drives the session, a post-workout protein shake drives the recovery.
